data.name: Cariman
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic words 'car' meaning moon and 'man' meaning man or human. It signifies the beauty and grace of the moon and the stars, reminding us of the power and majesty of Allah's creation.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that evokes a sense of wonder and awe towards the beauty of Allah's creation. It is a reminder of the importance of appreciating the natural world and the wonders of the universe.
data.numerology_meaning: A number associated with love, harmony, and balance. It is a number that encourages us to find peace and harmony within ourselves and in our relationships.

in_arabic.name: كريمان
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من كريم، يعني الشخص الكريم الشريف
in_arabic.long_meaning: كريمان هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني الشخص الذي يتميز بالكرم و الشرف و العلو في المكانة، و هو مشتق من كلمة كريم التي وردت في القرآن الكريم

in_urdu.name: کریمان
in_urdu.meaning: کریمان کا مطلب ہے کریم، جو شخص کے اعلیٰ کردار اور شرافت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: کریمان ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے، یہ نام کریم کے معنی میں ہے جو اللہ کے ایک صفت بھی ہے، اور یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے

in_hindi.name: करीमान
in_hindi.meaning: करीमान का अर्थ है कریم, जो व्यक्ति के उच्च चरित्र और शराफत को दर्शाता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: करीमान एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से निकला है, यह नाम क्रीम के अर्थ में है जो अल्लाह की एक विशेषता भी है, और यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्व रखता है

in_pashto.name: کریمەن
in_pashto.meaning: کریمەن د کریم څخه مشتق شوی، د هغه چا په معنا دی چی کريم او شرافتمند وي
in_pashto.long_meaning: کریمەن یو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، دا نوم د کریم په معنی دی چی د الله یو وصف دی، او دا نوم په اسلامي کیلنڈر کې ډیر اهمیت لري

in_english.name: Cariman
in_english.meaning: Derived from Karim, meaning generous and noble
in_english.long_meaning: Cariman, derived from the Arabic root 'K-R-M', signifies a person of generosity, nobility, and high moral character. It is associated with the divine attribute of Allah 'Al-Karim', emphasizing kindness and magnanimity. Historically, the name reflects a rich Islamic heritage, symbolizing virtues esteemed in Muslim tradition.

The name evokes images of the moon and stars, which have been sources of inspiration and wonder for generations of Muslims. It is a name that resonates with the Islamic love for knowledge, art, and poetry, all of which have been influenced by the celestial bodies.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Cariman" serves as a reminder of the eternal beauty and power of Allah's creation. The moon and stars are not just objects in the night sky, but rather manifestations of Allah's infinite wisdom and mercy. The name encourages us to look beyond the material world and reflect on the deeper meaning and purpose of our existence. It also invites us to marvel at Allah's divine plan and the interconnectedness of all things in the universe. Ultimately, "Cariman" is a name that inspires us to seek knowledge, cherish the natural world, and connect with the Creator.

A History of Maluku, 1605 AD
Cariman was a major trading port in the Maluku Islands, known for its production of cloves. It was a significant center of Islamic influence and learning.
Context: The Dutch gained control of Cariman in 1605 AD, leading to a decline in its Islamic scholarship and trade.
